title: Check security modules and mount topology in the native view entry
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add a concrete native-entry proposal with actual bounded LSM enumeration, mount census and held-FD mount joins, plus conditional kernel proofs and two new mocked-constructor control suites. The complete caller proof and connected parent integration remain open; this is a completed scoped native prerequisite, not a full-caller qualification or performance claim.

The proposed 53,074-byte C source has SHA256 `e1740fc6c901e09477ff0d934a920ca51dfe1a4b199d14e3433e155f1ef30fb2`. It checks the complete capability/Landlock result, uses 129 slots for a 128-mount bound, validates exact returned masks and string bounds, joins real held-object unique mount IDs, and checks the source-owned two-clone view relation. Source bounds are 31 lifetime FD births, peak 13 tracked / 15 actual FDs, and 268 successful-path acquisition calls within a 288-attempt cap.

For the explicit prospective Linux v6.12 model with miscellaneous handlers, core dumping and module loading disabled, this successor omits the predecessor's private binfmt-instance and forced CORE setup. It preserves inherited CORE limits and ordinary self resource operations. Original native trust conditions, including initial Landlock/seccomp/BPF state, remain unissued qualification premises. No host configuration or selected full-caller source was changed.

## Validation

One independently admitted serial attempt compiled and ran each NEW mocked control once. All four steps returned zero, with known waits, both EOFs and no recorded errors. The policy control had empty stdout/stderr; the native-fact control matched its exact 64-byte success line and empty stderr. Each compile retained five indentation warnings, included in full and independently read. This is not a warning-free build.

The controls exercise actual proposed constructors through mocked native boundaries and independent positive, malformed, capacity, raw-error and policy oracles. No production entry, actual namespace/LSM/mount probe, original science or unchanged predecessor controls ran. Expected outer exit 137 is deliberate whole-owned-group retirement; acceptance rests on the four step records and raw captures.

The isolated archive contains 57 exact files. Passive integrity check passed:

```sh
python3 -B research/h25-native-view-facts/verify_integrity.py
```

No executable native/scientific replay hook is registered. The recorded absolute-path guard is actual local evidence, not a portable replay command. The new conservative policy debit is 64 seconds; recorded aggregate 1,520.890533479 / 2,400 seconds. Complete physical, preparation, Pro/review, reporting, publication, final metadata and historical costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`. Hosted outcomes will be recorded against the submitted head.
